title: Farm Scene 7 — Morning Jobs on the Farm
purpose: Support sequencing, action verbs and functional farm language using a busy but clear morning-jobs scene.

sentenceModels: The child is watering the plants.
The child is feeding the chickens.
The child is carrying the vegetables.
The child is sweeping the path.

adultSupport.focus: Use the picture to talk about morning jobs on a farm and to build simple first/then sequences.
starterPrompts: What job is happening on the path?
expansionPrompts: Tell me the farm story from first to last.
Which job helps the garden? Which job helps the chickens?

visualAudit: Reviewed in Wave 3 Batch 3 automatic pass against the main teaching targets.
